subject.title: feat(qwen): add Token Plan (Team Edition) provider

question: Should OpenClaw accept Alibaba Model Studio Token Plan as a bundled qwen provider/auth surface, including runtime-only bailian-token-plan custom-provider ownership?
rationale: The patch looks technically coherent, but it adds public provider IDs, auth choices, an env var, endpoint metadata, docs, and catalog rows that become maintainer-owned setup and provider contracts.

options.title: Accept bundled Token Plan provider
options.body: Treat qwen-token-plan and qwen-token-plan-cn as official qwen plugin surfaces and land after current-head checks refresh.

options.title: Route to an external plugin
options.body: Decline the bundled surface and ask for Token Plan support to live as a separate provider plugin if maintainers do not want another Alibaba contract in core distribution.

options.title: Narrow before merge
options.body: Keep only the canonical provider or require stronger vendor-proofed docs for bailian-token-plan and CN support before accepting the full surface.

recommendation.title: Accept bundled Token Plan provider
recommendation.body: Treat qwen-token-plan and qwen-token-plan-cn as official qwen plugin surfaces and land after current-head checks refresh.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete is the PR assignee, current branch committer, and strongest qwen-provider history owner.
